text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — quarterly entitlement sweep is next week. Can we combine KMS key access review, admin entitlement cleanup, and the vuln triage notes into a single runbook?
Maria Gomez: +1. Prefer one coordinated window. Question: do we include ephemeral admin sessions (just-in-time) in the sweep or treat them separate?
Jordan Park: Treat ephemeral (JIT) differently — we should verify their grant logs rather than static role bindings. We have STS/OKTA events for that.
Priya Nair: For KMS specifically, compliance wants proof of key usage and which principal requested decrypts in the quarter. We should pull CloudTrail + KMS audit logs.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Maria, can you own the KMS extraction? I can handle RBAC role bindings and ownerless role detection.
Maria Gomez: I can. Quick snippet to query last 90 days decrypts from CloudTrail:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-12-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 --query 'Events[].{time:EventTime, user:Username, arn:Resources[0].ARN}'
```
Jordan Park: Nice. Add filter for AssumeRole events to map ephemeral sessions back to source users. Eg grep for "AssumeRole" and then join on sessionName.
Priya Nair: For entitlement cleanup, can we run ownerless-role detection across GCP/IAM + AWS + internal service accounts? I want a CSV with: principal, role, last-used, owner.
Alex Chen: We'll use access-cert tool for CSV output. If last-used > 180 days or owner blank -> flag for rotation/ownership assignment.
Maria Gomez: Also: ensure KMS key policies don't implicitly grant full admin to any team role. We found one key with broad "kms:Encrypt" to "svc-infra" last quarter.
sec-bot: Reminder: scheduled snapshot of IAM policies and KMS key policies will run at 2026-03-03T02:00Z.
Jordan Park: Vulnerability triage: CVE-2026-0142 affects our infra agent that can escalate privileges if combined with broad role binding. We've got a patch but need to ensure no admin roles are exposed.
Priya Nair: Action list draft:
- Maria: KMS decrypt/usage export + join to AssumeRole sessions (due Thu)
- Alex: Ownerless roles query + CSV (due Thu)
- Jordan: Run vuln scan on infra agent pods, produce mitigations (due Wed)
- All: 1-hour sync Fri 10:00 PT to review results and approve removals
Alex Chen: One more — for SOC audit we need a signed artifact showing key access review and admin removals. Maria, can your export be signed or we can put checksum in internal S3 with KMS encryption?
Maria Gomez: I'll write the export to compliance-bucket and encrypt with a dedicated audit KMS key, then post checksum here.
Jordan Park: If we remove any admin bindings, plan a short canary window with rollback steps. Document rollback steps in the runbook.
Priya Nair: I'll create the runbook stub and attach rollback playbook.
Alex Chen: Great. If anyone spots ownerless service accounts that are active, defer deletion — rotate creds and assign owner first.
Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll post the CloudTrail query results and checksum by EOD Wednesday.
sec-bot: Incident note: last recorded privilege escalation attempt blocked 2026-02-28T17:43Z — details in #incidents.
Jordan Park: Thanks — will correlate that event with the vuln triage.
Priya Nair: Ping if you need access to the access-cert tool or extra IAM read perms.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. We'll reconvene Fri 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
